text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Silence Suzuka while walking in
the hall.
She's looking rather under the
weather.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I'm all right. I just have a
little
headache.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list_en: Want to rest for a while?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking a nice run would make me
feel
better. I don't wan—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka clasps her head in pain.
